scopeLimits: The city SmartMap public landing and topic-map listing identify a continuous cadastral map layer. Direct standard HTTPS retrieval of the interactive map shell failed TLS certificate validation; no bypass was attempted. No query or parcel selection was made and no geometry was retained.
